blocks.text: **Choose the reference group first.** P(A | B) = cases in both A and B / cases in B. In a two-way table, divide by the row total for a row percentage or by the column total for a column percentage.

blocks.setup: Practice A, Q1: 25 commuters; 10 cycle. Put commute status in rows and cycling status in columns.

steps.label: Requested group
steps.text: Commuters: the question asks what share of commuters cycle.

steps.label: Cell / row total
steps.text: 10 / 25 = 40.0% of commuters cycle (the commuters row percentage).

steps.label: If a column is requested
steps.text: Use that column's total instead. The prior column-percentage error used the row total.

blocks.takeaway: Report a percentage to one decimal place and name the reference group. (Outline; Notes §§1–2; Practice A Q1)

blocks.text: Row percentages sum to 100% across each row; column percentages sum to 100% down each column. (Notes §2.3)
